source.path: apps/mv-characters/stage/auto-materials.js, auto-recipe.js; library/core/pbr.js (copied unchanged to shared/auto-materials/ and shared/library/core/)
source.symbol: autoMaterial (one glTF material -> one r187 node material: SSS on skin texels, sheen on cloth, specular AA on metal, a matte response on dark fibre, the cloth roughness floor and specular cut)
source.note: The material an imported model's slot gets (tools/import-model.mjs). It is made from the glTF material the file carries (its own maps), which the runtime hands over as ctx.source (lib/runtime/materials.mjs make(..., { source })); tint multiplies the colour (white leaves the file's colour as it is). r187 examples behind the recipe: webgpu_materials_sss, webgpu_loader_gltf_sheen, webgpu_loader_gltf. glow (0 to 1, default 0) lets the surface give off a little of its own colour, more at grazing angles (a rim): the waves' sand ghosts use it to read against a dusk scene; 0 leaves the material as the recipe made it.
